notes.title: 2023 Development Plan
notes.notes:
Hello, long time no see. Don't worry, we are still working hard on our "Little Broken Island". At the beginning of the year, we released the first package. After a small-scale test organized by the company, more than 70 bugs were found. For this reason, we started the crazy overtime mode! !

Very objectively speaking, the difficulty of developing this "Little Broken Island" is greater than our expectations. Although it is an independent game, it is also an online game that supports continuous iterative updates. We need to apply it to Many large-scale MMO game technical solutions and a large number of supporting gameplay to support.

But spring returns to the land and everything recovers. We believe that in the near future, we will have "the tide is flat and the banks are wide, and the wind is rising and the sail is hanging"!

Synchronize the follow-up plan for all friends as follows:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43436105/ea43fdba5fe73661e6ec5fd0e7a4fbb284b4e687.png[/img]

As mentioned above, we believe that after the above development content is gradually implemented in the game, we will have an exquisite, fun and interesting game! We believe that we are definitely not a copy game of Dongsen, but an ideal game with our own understanding!

Game development is a long and difficult process, especially for a small company like ours, there will be many challenges in the middle, but as developers, we are also players, we hope that the games we make can be worthy of everyone's expectations and be worthy of everyone's support support! Recently, we have modified the proportion of the character to make him more harmonious and beautiful. Please look to the left.

notes.title: Welcome to 2023! The new game content will soon meet you
notes.notes:
hello everyone. I'm "Stone", the game producer. I wish you all a happy and safe 2023.

I have been waiting for a long time on this day. I am very happy to introduce the beloved of our studio, "ENCOUNTER OF ISLAND"


1. We are a multi platform independent game. Support PC, Mac and mobile terminal.

2. As a simulation business game, we try our best to restore the essence of the word "simulation" in terms of resource acquisition and growth. We can cook, fish, cut down trees, brush the ground, farm and raise fish. All our production resources are either native, self cultivated or obtained through trading. For this reason, we have designed a complex trading system similar to "futures".

3. Not only designers, but also players. As a group of hardcore users of farming simulation games, we always feel lonely. We hope that in our games, we can meet our favorite peers, play together, chat together, and even walk into each other's real life. So we will try our best to do a good job in social design. Different from traditional farming games, we want to be a social, warm and dreamy game world.

4. We hope we are a game that is free enough but not difficult. So in island diy, we try our best to increase the degree of design freedom, enrich the style of furniture and house components as much as possible, and reduce the complex design that is useless for DIY as much as possible. All our designs want to restore a carefree and free farming game that farmers like.

Thank you for your expectation and support to us. Come on!
